steps: The grinding operation is performed on Grinding Machines using a ceramic bonded wheel at 1200 rpm and a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev, processing a planed part on the ConveyorBelt for 83 minutes to produce a ground part that exits on the ConveyorBelt.

Punching is performed on a Punch Press for 46 minutes using a 10 mm punch size with a stroke speed of 80 mm/min and die alignment within ±0.05 mm, starting with a sheet metal component on a conveyor belt and resulting in a finished cut sheet metal product being transferred to a mobile robot.

The honing operation, performed on a Honing Machine for 63 minutes, processes a honed cylinder on a ConveyorBelt to produce a precision finished ground part also on a ConveyorBelt, using a honing grit size of 60 and a bore size of 50 mm, with a cycle time of 30 seconds per cycle.
Sawing a metal bar using a Bandsaw for 19 minutes at 1500 rpm with a high-carbon steel blade and a 10 mm cutting width, producing a lathed part that is transferred to a mobile robot.

A shaping operation is performed on a Shaper for 28 minutes using a high-speed steel tool, with a stroke length of 80 mm and a shaping speed of 60 mm/min, transforming a milled part on the ConveyorBelt into a shaped part that is then conveyed out on the ConveyorBelt.

Roughing milling is performed on a Vertical Milling Machine for 87 minutes using an end mill with 4 flutes at a milling speed of 1000 rpm and a depth of cut of 2 mm, transforming a lathed part on the ConveyorBelt into a milled part that remains on the ConveyorBelt.

Finishing milling is performed on a Horizontal Milling Machine for 91 minutes using a contour profile with 3-axis offset tool path at a milling speed of 1200 rpm to achieve a surface finish of Ra 1.6 µm, starting with a milled part on a ConveyorBelt and ending with the finished machined component transferred to a MobileRobot.

A tapered broach is used on a Broaching Machine to broach a Metal bar on a ConveyorBelt for 61 minutes at a feed rate of 0.2 mm/rev and a depth of cut of 15 mm, resulting in a BroachedComponent being conveyed on the ConveyorBelt.

A CNC Turning operation is performed on a CNC Turning Center for 14 minutes using a standard gear shaft profile cnc program, with tool offsets of ±0.02 mm and a spindle speed of 1800 rpm, starting with a lathed part on a conveyor belt and ending with a finished machined component transferred to a mobile robot.

The laser cutting operation is performed on a Laser Cutter for 84 minutes using a laser power of 2 kW, a cutting speed of 12 mm/s, and nitrogen gas assist at 10 bar, transforming a sheet metal component on the conveyor belt into a cut sheet metal product also on the conveyor belt.
A spur gear with 24 teeth is shaped on a Gear Shaper for 9 minutes at a shaping speed of 30 rpm, starting from a broached component on a ConveyorBelt and ending as a shaped gear on a MobileRobot.

Shearing of sheet metal on the Shear (Sheet Metal) machine for 91 minutes using a cold-rolled steel blade at a cutting speed of 100 mm/min and a shear angle of 90 degrees, converting the input sheet metal on the ConveyorBelt into sheared sheet metal on the ConveyorBelt.
On the Screw Machines, a lathed part is screwed using an M8 screw with a coarse thread for 24 minutes to produce a screwed component, which is then transferred to a mobile robot.

A turning operation is performed on a Vertical Lathe for 28 minutes using a Carbide turning tool at a rotation speed of 600 rpm and a feed rate of 0.15 mm/rev, converting a Metal bar from the ConveyorBelt into a Lathed part which is then placed back on the ConveyorBelt.

Turning is performed on a Horizontal Lathe for 60 minutes using a High-speed steel tool at a rotation speed of 450 rpm and a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev, starting with a Metal bar on the ConveyorBelt and producing a Lathed part on the ConveyorBelt.

A precision milling operation is performed on the Stewart Platform Mills for 26 minutes using a 5-axis tool head with a milling precision of ±0.005 mm and an active vibration damping system, transforming a milled part on the conveyor belt into a ground part that remains on the conveyor belt.

A broached component is hobbed on a Hobbing Machine for 11 minutes at a hobbing speed of 100 rpm and a feed rate of 0.05 mm/rev using a standard involute profile to produce a hobbied gear, which is then transferred to a mobile robot.

A planing operation is performed on a Planer for 6 minutes to convert a Milled part into a Planed part, with a cut depth of 2 mm, a feed rate of 0.3 mm/rev, and a surface finish of Ra 3.2 µm, and the finished part is conveyed back to the ConveyorBelt.

A precision EDM cutting operation is performed on a Wire EDM (Electrical Discharge Machine) for 4 minutes using a molybdenum wire with pulse width of 50 ns, peak current of 15 A, and a cutting speed of 0.5 mm/min, transforming a shaped part on a conveyor belt into a precision finished part that is transferred to a mobile robot.

A drilling operation is performed on a Metal bar using a Drill Press for 96 minutes at a spindle speed of 1400 rpm, a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev, and a drill size of 6 mm, resulting in a DrilledComponent that is then transferred to the ConveyorBelt.

Turning is performed on a Vertical Lathe for 70 minutes using a high-speed steel tool at a rotation speed of 800 rpm and a feed rate of 0.2 mm/rev, starting with a metal bar on a ConveyorBelt and producing a lathed part on the same ConveyorBelt.

Roughing milling is performed on a Vertical Milling Machine for 72 minutes using an end mill with 4 flutes at a milling speed of 1200 rpm and a depth of cut of 2.0 mm, starting with a lathed part on the ConveyorBelt and producing a milled part on the ConveyorBelt.

A CNC Finishing Turning operation is performed on a CNC Turning Center for 45 minutes using a standard finish program for gear shafts, with tools calibrated to a 0.005 mm tolerance and the spindle speed set at 1500 rpm, starting with a lathed part on a conveyor belt and producing a finished machined component that is transferred to a mobile robot.

Finishing milling is performed on a Horizontal Milling Machine for 50 minutes using a milling speed of 1000 rpm, following a contour along the outer surface to achieve a surface finish of Ra 1.6 µm, starting with a milled part on a ConveyorBelt and ending with a finished machined component transferred to a MobileRobot.

A drilling operation is performed on a metal bar using a drill press for 1 minutes at a spindle speed of 1800 rpm, with a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev and a drill size of 6.0 mm, resulting in a drilled component on the conveyor belt.

Turning is performed on a Horizontal Lathe for 46 minutes using a Carbide tool at a rotation speed of 900 rpm and a feed rate of 0.15 mm/rev, starting with a Metal bar on the ConveyorBelt and producing a Lathed part on the ConveyorBelt.

Shearing of sheet metal on the Shear (Sheet Metal) machine for 67 minutes using a high-carbon steel blade at a shear angle of 45 degrees and a cutting speed of 12 m/min, starting with sheet metal on the conveyor belt and producing sheared sheet metal on the conveyor belt.
A metal bar is sawed on a Bandsaw for 43 minutes at a saw speed of 1000 rpm using a tungsten carbide blade with a cutting width of 50 mm to produce a lathed part.

A broaching operation is performed on a Broaching Machine for 75 minutes to cut an internal thread using a tapered broach with a feed rate of 0.3 mm/stroke and a depth of cut of 15 mm, starting with a Metal bar on a ConveyorBelt and producing a Broached component on the same ConveyorBelt.

The honing operation on the Honing Machine finishes a honed cylinder part for 44 minutes using a 60 grit honing tool with a bore size of 50.0 mm, starting with the honed cylinder on the MobileRobot and producing a precision finished part of the same type on the MobileRobot.

A planing operation is performed on a Planer for 62 minutes to convert a Milled part into a Planed part, with a planing depth of 3.0 mm, a feed rate of 0.5 mm/pass, and a surface finish of Ra 3.2 μm, and the processed part is conveyed out on the ConveyorBelt.

The sheet metal is laser cut on the Laser Cutter for 91 minutes at a laser power of 2.0 kW, a cutting speed of 8 m/min, with nitrogen gas assist, producing a cut sheet metal that remains on the ConveyorBelt.
On the Screw Machines, a lathed part is screwed using an M6 screw with a coarse thread for 99 minutes to produce a screwed component, which is then transferred to a mobile robot.

A broached component is hobbed on a Hobbing Machine for 96 minutes at a hobbing speed of 800 rpm and a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev, following a standard 20° pressure angle gear profile, resulting in a hobbied gear that is conveyed out on the ConveyorBelt.

The shaping operation is performed on a Shaper for 34 minutes using a tapered shaping tool with a stroke length of 100 mm and a shaping speed of 20 mm/min, starting with a milled part on the ConveyorBelt and producing a shaped part on the ConveyorBelt.

Punching is performed on a Punch Press for 60 minutes to form the finished sheet metal product from a sheet metal input, using a 10 mm punch size, a stroke speed of 150 mm/sec, and die alignment within ±0.05 mm, with the material processed on a ConveyorBelt.

A wire EDM cutting operation is performed on a shaped part conveyed on a conveyor belt using a molybdenum wire with a peak current of 15A, pulse duration of 50ns, and a cutting speed of 0.05 mm/min, for 96 minutes, to produce a precision finished ground part that is transferred to a mobile robot.

A spur gear with 24 teeth is shaped on a Gear Shaper for 19 minutes at a shaping speed of 100 rpm, starting from a broached component on the ConveyorBelt and producing a shaped gear on the ConveyorBelt.

A precision milling operation is performed on the Stewart Platform Mills for 10 minutes using a 5-axis tool head with a milling precision of ±0.002 mm and an active vibration damping system, transforming a milled part on the conveyor belt into a ground part that is then output on the conveyor belt.

The grinding operation is performed on Grinding Machines using an Aluminum oxide wheel at 3000 rpm with a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev, processing a Planed part on the ConveyorBelt for 52 minutes to produce a Ground part on the ConveyorBelt.

A broached component is hobbed on a Hobbing Machine for 94 minutes at a hobbing speed of 1200 rpm and a feed rate of 0.2 mm/rev to produce a 20-degree involute shaped gear, with the input component fed on the ConveyorBelt and the output hobbied gear exiting on the ConveyorBelt.

A metal bar is sawed on a Bandsaw for 42 minutes at a saw speed of 3000 rpm using a carbon steel blade with 18 teeth and a cutting width of 20 mm, resulting in a lathed part that is transferred to a mobile robot.

On the Screw Machines, a lathed part is screwed using an M6 x 1.0 coarse trapezoidal thread to produce a drilled component, completed for 82 minutes at a production rate of 150 pieces per hour, with the input part transported by a mobile robot and the output component conveyed to the conveyor belt.

Punching is performed on a Punch Press for 39 minutes to cut 15 mm diameter holes in sheet metal supplied on a ConveyorBelt, with a stroke speed of 80 mm/min and die alignment within a ±0.05 mm tolerance, resulting in a finished cut sheet metal product being transferred to a MobileRobot.

A milling operation is performed on a Vertical Milling Machine for 33 minutes using an end mill with 4 flutes at a milling speed of 1500 rpm and a depth of cut of 2 mm, transforming a lathed part carried by a mobile robot into a milled part that is then transferred to a conveyor belt.

A shaping operation is performed on a Gear Shaper for 48 minutes to cut a spur gear with 48 teeth at a shaping speed of 60 mm/min, starting with a broached component on a ConveyorBelt and producing a shaped gear that is transferred to a MobileRobot.

A drilling operation is performed on a Metal bar using a Drill Press for 93 minutes at a spindle speed of 1800 rpm, a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev, and a drill size of 6 mm, resulting in a DrilledComponent that is transferred to a MobileRobot.

The hobbing operation is performed on a Hobbing Machine for 38 minutes at a hobbing speed of 80 rpm and a feed rate of 0.2 mm/rev, using a 20° pressure angle gear profile, transforming a broached component on a ConveyorBelt into a hobbied gear on a MobileRobot.

A spur gear with 24 teeth is shaped on a Gear Shaper for 84 minutes at a shaping speed of 45 rpm, starting from a broached component on the ConveyorBelt and producing a shaped gear on the ConveyorBelt.

A horizontal milling operation is performed on a Horizontal Milling Machine for 21 minutes using a contour cutting tool path with 3-axis motion, at a milling speed of 1000 rpm, to achieve a surface finish of Ra 1.6 μm, starting with a milled part held by a mobile robot and ending with a finished machined component transferred to a conveyor belt.

A Bandsaw Cutting operation is performed for 57 minutes using a Tungsten carbide blade at a saw speed of 18 m/min and a cutting width of 50 mm, starting with a Metal bar on a ConveyorBelt and producing a Lathed part that is transferred to a MobileRobot.

The grinding operation is performed on Grinding Machines using an aluminum oxide wheel at 3000 rpm with a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev, processing a planed part on a conveyor belt for 72 minutes to produce a ground part that is transferred to a mobile robot.

Punching is performed on a Punch Press for 8 minutes using a 10 mm diameter punch with a stroke speed of 120 mm/min and high precision die alignment within ±0.05 mm, processing sheet metal input on a conveyor belt to produce a finished sheet metal product on the same conveyor belt.

A CNC Turning operation is performed on a CNC Turning Center for 55 minutes using a standard gear shaft profile CNC program, with tool offsets calibrated to 0.02 mm and a spindle speed of 1500 rpm, starting with a lathed part held by a mobile robot and ending with a finished machined component transferred to a conveyor belt.

A tapered broach is used on a Broaching Machine to broach a Metal bar for 56 minutes at a feed rate of 0.3 mm/rev and a depth of cut of 15 mm, resulting in a Broached component that is transferred to a MobileRobot.

A drilling operation is performed on a Metal bar using a Drill Press for 23 minutes at a spindle speed of 1200 rpm, a feed rate of 0.15 mm/rev, and a drill size of 6 mm, resulting in a DrilledComponent that is then conveyed on the ConveyorBelt.

A vertical milling operation is performed on a Vertical Milling Machine for 4 minutes using an end mill with a milling speed of 1000 rpm, a depth of cut of 3 mm, starting with a lathed part carried by a mobile robot and ending with a milled part transferred to a conveyor belt.

The honing operation is performed on a Honing Machine for 57 minutes to finish a honed cylinder component on a conveyor belt, using a 60 grit honing tool with a 50 mm bore size and a cycle time of 30 seconds per pass, resulting in a precision finished part that is transferred to a mobile robot.

A precision milling operation is performed on a Stewart Platform Mill for 56 minutes using a 5-axis tool set with a milling precision of ±0.01 mm and an active vibration damping system, transforming a milled part on a conveyor belt into a ground part that is then transferred to a mobile robot.

A wire EDM cutting operation is performed on a shaped part conveyed on a conveyor belt using a molybdenum wire with a pulse duration of 50 ns, voltage of 60 V, and a cutting speed of 0.5 mm/min, for 58 minutes, to produce a precision finished part that is transferred to a mobile robot.

A Vertical Lathe Turning operation is performed for 27 minutes on a Metal bar input component using a Carbide turning tool at a rotation speed of 600 rpm and a feed rate of 0.2 mm/rev, resulting in a Lathed part output component that is conveyed to the next stage.

The planing operation is performed on a Planer for 66 minutes to reduce the surface of a Milled part to a Planed part, with a planing depth of 5 mm, a feed rate of 10 mm/min, and a surface finish of Ra 3.2 µm, with the input component transported by a MobileRobot and the output component conveyed to a ConveyorBelt.

A Horizontal Lathe Turning operation is performed for 11 minutes using a High-speed steel tool at a rotation speed of 800 rpm and a feed rate of 0.15 mm/rev, starting with a Metal bar on a ConveyorBelt and ending with a Lathed part transferred to a MobileRobot.
